annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Communication from the Commission ... — Coordinated Plan on Artificial Intelligence' (COM(2018) 795 final)
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Coordinated Plan on Artificial Intelligence (COM(2018) 795 final)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 240/51
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion welcoming the Commission's 2018 Coordinated Plan on AI. It urges rapid implementation, more funding, an enabling regulatory environment with sandboxes, data access, education and reskilling, inclusiveness, sustainable development and trustworthy 'human in command' AI. Robotics appears only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Urges swift implementation of the Coordinated Plan and more EU and Member State funding for AI
Calls for an enabling, non-overly-detailed regulatory framework and regulatory sandboxes
Calls for review of safety and liability legislation for fitness regarding trustworthy AI
Stresses education reform, lifelong learning and a European transition fund for digital change
Proposes sustainable development as guiding framework and 'human in command' principle
